content: Merry Christmas to all, and to all a good fight. Violent Night 2 only in theaters December 4. If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice. David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North—the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise—and returning action director Tommy Wirkola. In 2022’s bare-knuckle holiday sensation, Violent Night, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall. But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2). Violent Night 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film’s returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures. chineseContent: 祝大家圣诞快乐，祝大家打得愉快。 《暴力之夜 2》仅在 12 月 4 日上映。如果你表现得好，你会得到大人物的礼物。如果你顽皮，你就会得到正义。大卫·哈伯 (David Harbour) 在 87North 的圣诞混乱中再次扮演圣诞老人，该公司是《子弹头列车》、《疾速追杀》、《替罪羊》、《极寒之城》和《无名小卒》系列的强大制作人，并且回归了动作导演汤米·维尔科拉。在 2022 年轰动一时的节日《暴力之夜》中，一位心怀怨恨的圣诞老人，凭借致命的战斗技能，率领一队雇佣兵营救了一名女孩和她的家人。现在，不那么快乐的圣尼克再次装扮起来，对抗一个残酷的黑帮（艾美奖和金球奖提名者贾里德·哈里斯饰），他恐吓银铃购物中心的商人。但当圣诞老人忘记了圣诞节的真正意义时，他发现自己身处一个热闹的购物中心社区的中心，迫切需要他的帮助。魔力被耗尽后，他需要另一种方式来对抗威胁商场的暴徒，而时间已经不多了。圣诞老人必须重新找回他对善良的信念，并在最后一刻从坏人不想与之纠缠的人那里召唤一些增援：克劳斯夫人（艾美奖和金球奖提名克里斯汀·贝尔饰）。除了大卫·哈伯、贾里德·哈里斯和克里斯汀·贝尔之外，充满活力的演员阵容还包括艾美奖得主银幕传奇人物乔·潘托里亚诺（《最后生还者》、《黑道家族》）、丹妮拉·梅尔基奥（《速度与激情》、《银河护卫队 3》）、安德鲁·巴什勒（《格林兰》、《行尸走肉》）和 AEW 职业摔跤手麦克斯韦·弗里德曼（《铁爪》、《快乐吉尔摩 2》）。 《暴力之夜 2》由回归电影制片人汤米·维尔科拉 (Tommy Wirkola) 执导，并由 87North 创始人凯利·麦考密克 (Kelly McCormick) 和大卫·雷奇 (David Leitch) 再次制作。该片回归的编剧是帕特·凯西和乔什·米勒。暴力之夜
